title: 7.15 A Day with Friends
unit_title: Unit 7: My Body, My Day and My Free Time
unit_outcome: Name the body and clothes, say how you feel and what the weather is like, talk about free time, make plans with friends and ask someone to repeat.
goal: Go with Ana to the park: get ready, travel, find the way, meet friends and answer out loud.
grammar_function: All German A1 patterns, in the final mission.
speaking_outcome: Get through a day with friends out loud.
